whenToUse: Use designsetgo/accordion for FAQs and other collapsible content organization — a list of questions/topics where only the relevant panel needs to be visible at once. Every child must be a designsetgo/accordion-item; accordion-item is not a standalone block.
avoid: Do not add a designsetgo/accordion-item outside a designsetgo/accordion — accordion-item declares designsetgo/accordion as its only valid parent.

Do not mark more than one accordion-item isOpen: true when allowMultipleOpen is false (the default) — only one panel can actually be open at a time, so the others' isOpen: true is misleading authoring.
Do not leave an accordion-item's innerBlocks empty — a panel with no content has nothing to reveal when expanded.
Do not use accordion for primary page navigation or a small (1-2 item) list where the content could just be shown directly — reach for it when there are several optional-to-read items.

attributes.content: DesignSetGo is a block library for the WordPress block editor, covering layout, content, and interactive blocks.

attributes.title: Does it work with any block theme?

attributes.content: Yes — every block reads colors, spacing, and typography from the active theme's theme.json.
